description: Integration end-to-end smoke test and README. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (all C binaries must build). This FEAT adds a shell-based integration smoke test script (tests/integration_smoke.sh) that exercises INT-01 through INT-10 from the test plan using the actual built binaries, plus a complete README.md with build/run/test instructions. No new C source — this is verification and documentation.
steps: Write tests/integration_smoke.sh: bash script that (1) starts three demo_backend processes on 9001/9002/9003, (2) starts edgemesh, (3) waits 12 seconds for health probes to complete (2 successes × 5s = 10s + buffer), (4) sends 6 sequential curl GET requests to http://127.0.0.1:8080/ and verifies each returns 200 and 'Backend at port', (5) checks that over 6 requests all three backends appear in responses (round_robin), (6) sends a PUT to http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/policy with body '{"policy":"least_connections"}' and verifies 200 response, (7) sends an invalid PUT with body '{"policy":"bad_value"}' and verifies 400 response, (8) calls all six GET admin endpoints and verifies each returns HTTP 200 and valid JSON (using python3 -m json.tool or jq), (9) kills one demo_backend and waits for health check interval + threshold (18s = 3 failures * 5s probe interval + buffer) then verifies GET /api/v1/backends shows that backend as 'unhealthy', (10) sends a request to 8080 and verifies other backends still serve, (11) kills all demo_backends and verifies HTTP 503 from proxy, (12) restarts demo_backends and waits for recovery then verifies healthy again. Script exits 0 on all pass, 1 on any failure. Prints PASS/FAIL for each check.

Add the integration test to CMakeLists.txt as a CTest test: add_test(NAME integration_smoke COMMAND bash ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/integration_smoke.sh WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}). Mark it with set_tests_properties(integration_smoke PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 150).

Overwrite README.md with complete documentation: project description, prerequisites (WSL Ubuntu 22.04, GCC, CMake, Node.js 20), exact build commands (cmake configure + build + ctest), exact run commands (start 3 demo backends, start edgemesh, dashboard dev server), exact benchmark command example, exact curl examples for every admin endpoint, known limitations (HTTP/1.1 subset only, no TLS, no persistent connections, loopback only, educational prototype), and link to docs/.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration_smoke.sh is executable and passes when all three demo backends and edgemesh are running
README.md contains build, run, test, and benchmark instructions that match the actual CMake targets and binary names
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -R integration_smoke passes (requires network access to loopback)
verification: wsl -e bash -c "cd /mnt/c/Users/HARI/Downloads/flutter/edgemesh && cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -R integration_smoke 2>&1"
findings:
All 16 integration checks passed. Test ran in 68s (well under 150s timeout).

Files created/changed:
  tests/integration_smoke.sh   — 16-check end-to-end smoke test covering INT-01 through INT-10
  CMakeLists.txt               — added integration_smoke CTest entry with TIMEOUT 150
  README.md                    — complete build/run/test/benchmark/admin-API documentation
  src/admin_api/handler.c      — two bug fixes:
    1. PUT method support: parser returns PARSE_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED for non-GET methods;
       added inline re-parse of method+target from raw buffer when parser rejects the method,
       allowing PUT /api/v1/policy to dispatch correctly.
    2. read_body buffering: read_with_timeout may pull body bytes into hdr_buf beyond \r\n\r\n;
       updated read_body to accept hdr_buf/hlen and copy already-buffered body bytes first
       before reading remaining bytes from the socket.

Startup wait adjusted from 2s to 12s (UNKNOWN->HEALTHY requires 2 consecutive probe successes
at 5s intervals = 10s minimum).

Build: cmake --build build --parallel exit 0, zero warnings.
Unit tests (5): 100% passed.
Integration smoke: 16/16 PASS in 68s.
